features.availability: all features end at the completed hour immediately before the executable next-hour open

model.continuous_scaling: StandardScaler fit on the training partition only
model.target: arithmetic return from the next-hour open to the close exactly 24 hours later

pre2024_selection_already_observed.base_threshold_definition: 95th percentile of absolute Q3 predictions from the H1-fitted model
pre2024_selection_already_observed.q3_gate: at least 5 completed trades; positive 24bp return, median and PF; MDD below 35%; positive exact top-10%-winner-removed reroute
pre2024_selection_already_observed.q4_gate: at least 3 completed trades; same unchanged economic and winner-removal requirements

frozen_2024h1_system.model_update: refit the identical Ridge pipeline on every eligible 2023 row; do not change features, alpha or target
frozen_2024h1_system.entry: at the next SOLUSDT hourly open only during UTC 00:00-11:59 when prediction is at or below -0.013466328577653525
frozen_2024h1_system.exit: at the next hourly open when the signed short expected edge is no longer positive
frozen_2024h1_system.quantity: fixed base quantity opened at one-times current NAV notional; no free hourly rebalancing
frozen_2024h1_system.funding_proxy: adverse 1bp of current marked notional at UTC 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 while held
frozen_2024h1_system.same_timestamp_ordering: mark existing position, charge due funding, apply exit, then permit a new entry
frozen_2024h1_system.period_end: mark to market with estimated exit cost; do not force close
frozen_2024h1_system.winner_removal: remove max(1, ceil(10% of all completed trades)) largest positive-PnL start keys before slot competition and replay from initial NAV

decision.positive_robust_path: insert immediately into the cumulative ranking with provisional proxy confidence and proceed to unchanged exact-Bybit execution; risk/leverage search may open only after positive winner-removal evidence
decision.negative_or_winner_dependent_path: retire this pre-2024-selected route and do not tune adjacent sessions, symbols, sides, thresholds, features or Ridge alpha
